subject: executor: don't scanRowTable if build stage meet error (#60467)
summary: Reviewed commit vs its parent: it threads a build-error/close signal from `wait4BuildSide()` into `HashJoinV2Exec.waitJoinWorkers()` to skip `scanRowTableAfterProbeDone()` when build fails/exec closes, avoiding post-build-error row-table scans. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in executor correctness/concurrency for this change; later upstream commit 8746e39b65 (#60531) further refines the gate to `buildSuccess` (including restore mode).
